UpdateAIGateway.X-Region: Region code, e.g. bj, gz, su, cd, yq, bd
UpdateAIGateway.name: Instance name
UpdateAIGateway.publicAccessible: Whether to allow public network access
UpdateAIGateway.replicas: Number of replicas; server-side valid range is 2-5
UpdateAIGateway.networkTypes: Network type: private, public; multiple selections allowed
UpdateAIGateway.tags: Tag list; omitting this field means no change, empty array means clear all tags
